name: The American College of Greece (Deree)
summary: Private American-style college in Athens where all classes are in English; majors in business, arts and sciences, and you can enter undecided.

ib.text: The IB Diploma is accepted as proof of English. Admission is by transcripts, one teacher recommendation and an interview; no IB points or subjects are set. Merit awards cut tuition by 10% to 35%.

noDeadline: Rolling; the college suggests applying by 15 June

apply.via: Deree online application for EU students (free to apply)

faculties.name: School of Business and Economics
faculties.line: Majors from accounting, finance and economics to international business, marketing and shipping; the page lists no entry subjects.

faculties.name: Frances Rich School of Arts, Humanities and Social Sciences
faculties.line: Majors in music, theatre, cinema, design, humanities, communication and social sciences; the page lists no entry subjects.

faculties.name: School of Science and Technology
faculties.line: Majors in IT, cybersecurity, computer science, biomedical sciences, environmental studies and psychology; no entry subjects listed.

notes: All classes are in English, you can enter undecided and declare a major around your second year, and a double major is possible.
Tuition is charged per credit and is the same table for EU students and other countries: €400 a credit at 15 or more credits in 2026-27, plus a €54 matriculation fee.
Full-time students normally finish a US degree and an Open University validated award in four years; Greek recognition of the degree is a separate step for graduates.
